originals.ko: 휴식을 위해 눕는 게 더 좋을 거야

originals.why: Idiomatic North Welsh: 'yn y lle cynta'' means 'first of all' and works as a sentence opener here. The 어디 = lle gloss is a misleading hint, so the Korean ignores it.

originals.ko: 나는 누울 필요가 있어, 왜냐하면 우리가 어젯밤에 서로 봤거든
originals.why: Grammatical North Welsh: 'achos i ni weld ein gilydd' is the standard past clause after achos. The meaning is a little odd but makes sense here, and it uses the LEGO in its taught sense.
